limitations: Indexed note streams are a transitional input; Canonical IR attack/sounding IDs are not connected yet.
Arrival harmony is selected by overlap with the terminal melody sounding event; explicit Canonical IR tie chains remain required for durable provenance.
Chord and cadence strengths are uncalibrated evidence scores, not probabilities.
No cadence is inferred from a phrase boundary alone.
Surface templates are intentionally limited to major, minor, diminished, and dominant-seventh chords.
